name: Vericto Proxy MCP
description: Database guardrails for AI agents. vericto-proxy mcp is a local stdio MCP server that gives an agent read-only PostgreSQL access without a database credential: each statement is checked against Vericto rules before it runs, then runs read-only in a transaction that always rolls back, with row, size and time caps. execute_sql and describe_schema return rows and schema to the agent; check_sql evaluates locally and whoami reports the setup. Off until you turn it on.
saferAlternatives: Call check_sql before execute_sql: it evaluates the statement locally and returns findings and suggested fixes without running anything on the database.
Give the server a database role with read access only to the tables the agent needs; describe_schema then shows only what that role may read.
Keep every other database credential out of the agent's environment; whoami warns when one is visible, and what is checked is what runs only without it.
Link the server to a Vericto workspace for custom rules and sensitive-column masking; until its signed rules are in force execute_sql answers NOT_READY.
